author: ETA PRIME
description:
The Minisforum X1 Lite might be the best budget mini PC of 2026—especially with USB4 and Oculink built in. In this first look, I test performance mode, real gaming, and power draw to see what you really get. Today I’m checking out the all-new Minisforum X1 Lite, a small form factor mini PC that packs the AMD Ryzen 7 255 (Zen 4, 8C/16T) and a Radeon 7 ATM iGPU (RDNA 3, 12 CUs)—plus some ports you usually don’t see at this price. I jump into the BIOS to switch to performance mode and bump UMA VRAM (up to 16GB available) for better iGPU headroom, then run benchmarks and real-world games at 1080p.
